items.q: Should I repair or replace my water heater?
items.a: If it's under about [8] years old and the tank isn't leaking, repair is usually worth it. If the tank itself is leaking or the unit is past [10–12] years, replacement is the better investment. We'll tell you which before we quote.
Yes, for scheduled service — repairs, water heaters, remodel work. For emergencies, call so we can help you shut off water while we're on the way.

items.q: How fast can you turn a bid?
items.a: Send plans and a fixture schedule and you'll have numbers back within [# business days]. A straight takeoff from your drawings, no padding.

items.q: What do you need from us to bid?
items.a: Plans (PDF is fine), the fixture schedule if you have one, and the job address. If plans aren't final, send what you have and we'll flag the assumptions in the number.
